title: ChatGPT Can Build Interactive Tools Now: 3 Useful GPT-6 Examples
description:
ChatGPT's GPT-6 Intelligent UI, announced October 7, 2026, turns some questions into interactive charts, controls, calculators and visual explanations. We explain the real value with three clearly labeled illustrative examples: a group-bill splitter, probability learning, and a workflow comparison. Learn the difference between visual answers and real app deployment, and which plans support the feature.

Every interface in this video is an ORIGINAL ILLUSTRATIVE RECONSTRUCTION, not an actual live ChatGPT recording or a claim that we performed a product benchmark.

Official sources:
https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-for-everyone/
https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001598-intelligent-ui-in-chatgpt
